summary: Elbit Systems Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing it was awarded contracts totaling approximately $200 million from the Israel Ministry of Defense for advanced airborne munitions. The press release contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a routine disclosure of a material contract award, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, premium, or advisor details. No shareholder action or regulatory clock is triggered. This is ordinary course business.
